description: This source file defines the feature for deleting comments within a Conduit-based ASP.NET Core application. It includes a command, validation, and a handler to remove a specific comment from an article identified by a slug.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to delete a comment, identified by article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the delete comment command; ensures slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: CommandValidator.constructor
methods.description: Initializes validation rules for the Command, primarily checking the Slug field.

methods.name: QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to delete a comment from the database based on the provided article slug and comment ID.
